summary: Completed comprehensive testing of R1-05 and R1-06 P0 bug fixes. All backend API tests passed (8/8). Frontend UI verification confirmed R1-05 implementation with 'On-Request' column and transparency fields present.
passed_tests: R1-06-1: Over-return blocked (qty=9999 > available 24) - Returns 400 with 'Retur melebihi batas' and 'maksimum' message
R1-06-2: Within-limit return allowed (qty=10, cumulative 16 ≤ 30) - Returns 200, creates return successfully
R1-06-3: Cumulative overflow blocked (16+20=36 > 30) - Returns 400 with 'Retur melebihi batas' message
R1-05-1: Reorder suggestions API returns 'on_request' and 'existing_prs' fields for all items
R1-05-2: Create open PR for prod_benang_katun (qty=100) - Returns 200, PR-00005 created
R1-05-3: Reorder suggestions correctly show on_request=100 and existing_prs=['PR-00005'] for prod_benang_katun
R1-05-4: Create second PR for prod_benang_katun (qty=200) - Returns 200, PR-00006 created
R1-05-5: Product prod_benang_katun removed from suggestions when fully covered (projected 390 > rop 250)
R1-05 Frontend: 'On-Request' column header present in reorder suggestions table
R1-05 Frontend: on_request data cells displayed with testid pattern 'reorder-onrequest-*' (4 cells found)
R1-05 Frontend: Table structure correct with 4 product rows using testid pattern 'reorder-row-*'
R1-05 Frontend: View loaded with correct title 'Saran Reorder · Replenishment'

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (UI elements verified, PR badge not visible as expected due to product removal)

notes.r1_06_validation: Sales return over-return validation working correctly. Backend enforces cumulative quantity cap based on shipped/sold quantity. Error messages are clear and informative.
notes.r1_05_transparency: Reorder suggestions anti-duplicate PR logic working correctly. The 'on_request' field tracks open PR quantities, and 'existing_prs' array shows PR numbers. Products are correctly removed from suggestions when projected stock (available + on_order + on_request) exceeds reorder point.
notes.pr_badge_absence: PR badges with testid 'reorder-pr-badge-*' were not found in the UI during testing. This is EXPECTED behavior because the test product (prod_benang_katun) was removed from the reorder suggestions list after creating PRs that fully covered its reorder point (projected 390 > rop 250). The badge would only appear for products that remain in the suggestions list AND have open PRs.
notes.data_integrity: Main agent reported verify_data_integrity gate PASS 125/0 including new L4-RET invariant for return quantity validation.
